scope: Curated families of related layout templates. Membership does not merge specimens, establish issue dates, or assert byte-identical geometry. Variant groups are referenced once; other members use stable patch IDs.

families.label: Forest Service tree oval
families.description: Tree-and-landscape oval with service wording, palette and attached-title variants.
families.basis: Existing Forest Oval variant group; inherited photographs and interpretation notes remain on each member.

families.label: Forests wildlife oval
families.description: Short Forests wording around the wildlife oval, with palette and Wildfire Service variants.
families.basis: Existing supplied Forest Oval recipe and variant group.

families.label: Long ministry wildlife oval
families.description: Wildlife oval with a longer ministry name and optional Wildfire Service wording.
families.basis: Existing supplied long-ministry recipe and variant group; names and dates are not interchangeable.

families.label: Forest Service yellow-sky oval
families.description: Yellow-sky oval in three recorded or reconstructed colour treatments.
families.basis: Existing variant group; printed-source media remain recorded per member.

families.label: Forest Service green-and-gold oval
families.description: Green-and-gold oval, light-band edition and generated colourways.
families.basis: Existing variant group; generated colourways remain interpretations, not newly documented specimens.

families.label: Forest Service / Parks tabbed oval
families.description: Tree oval with an attached Parks tab and backing or lettering variants.
families.basis: Existing supplied variant group; no claim that the two reconstruction packages use identical geometry.

families.label: Forest Service shoulder emblem
families.description: A shared Forest Service shoulder composition represented by two atlas occurrences.
families.basis: Existing forest-shoulder variant group.

families.label: BC Parks scenic arch
families.description: Scenic arch with Parks wording and an integrated Ranger edition.
families.basis: Existing supplied scenic-arch variant group.

families.label: Conservation Officer lower rocker
families.description: Separate lower title rocker in olive and green-and-gold treatments.
families.basis: Existing lower-role-rocker variant group; detached pieces remain separate from shoulder shields.

families.label: Provincial ministry shield
families.description: Arched British Columbia heading, small provincial arms and ministry name below. Related layouts span five organizations; wording, colours and dimensions remain distinct.
families.basis: Visual comparison of current previews and the corresponding source-labelled atlas designs. Shared arrangement, not proof of one manufacturer or identical outline.

families.label: Parks Branch semicircle
families.description: Semicircular BC Parks Branch title in beige, yellow and dark colour treatments.
families.basis: Constructed semicircle recipe in supplied/bc-parks-semicircles/; the later flag semicircle uses a different composition and stays separate.

families.label: Parks Branch title rocker
families.description: Detached Parks Branch title in two source occurrences.
families.basis: Same parks-branch-rocker atlas family and reviewed title layout; source occurrences remain distinct.

families.label: Parks / Outdoor Recreation rocker
families.description: Detached two-line Parks / Outdoor Recreation title.
families.basis: Same parks-outdoor-rocker atlas family and reviewed title layout.

families.label: Game Warden / Commissioner / Inspector cap
families.description: Arched British Columbia heading and stacked game-service role on a felt cap shape.
families.basis: Same moosecop-game-role-cap-v1 atlas family, reviewed against all three previews. Different offices are preserved as separate designs.

families.label: Game branch two-line flash
families.description: Two curved title lines on a detached felt or cloth flash, including Game Commission and Fish & Game Branch wording.
families.basis: Same moosecop-early-two-line-flash-v1 atlas family; wording, material and border differences stay on the members.

families.label: Wildlife / Predator division flash
families.description: Curved upper title with a rectangular Division extension below.
families.basis: Same moosecop-division-notch-flash-v1 family; the Wildlife Protection and Predator Control titles remain separate.

families.label: Fish & Game / Fish & Wildlife shield
families.description: Text-only branch title on a broad curved-top shield, with wording, material and border variants.
families.basis: Seven bc-fish-game-wildlife-branch-shield records plus S56-O42, whose preview shares this arrangement. The latter is related, not a proven duplicate specimen.

families.label: Conservation Officer compact shoulder shield
families.description: Compact shield with an upper role heading, small arms and ministry footer. The BC Environment edition changes the footer.
families.basis: Shared bc-co-compact-integrated atlas family. Historical wording and source-edition dates remain separate; the 1992 flag footer is a distinct edition.

families.label: Conservation Officer compact cap crest
families.description: Cap versions with the role and province above small arms and a ministry footer.
families.basis: Same bc-co-compact-integrated-1984-v1 atlas family. The source spelling error Enviroment is intentionally preserved in its member.

families.label: Conservation Officer Service shoulder
families.description: Modern service achievement on a tall shoulder patch, in officer and chief colour treatments.
families.basis: Same bc-co-service-2004-shoulder-v1 atlas family; rank differences remain separate.

families.label: Conservation centennial tab
families.description: Detached Centennial / 1905–2005 tab in blue and gold.
families.basis: Same bc-co-centennial-tab-2005-v1 atlas family. Tabs are not merged with the shoulder patches they accompany.

families.label: Deputy Sheriff title rocker
families.description: Detached single-line Deputy Sheriff title in white and gold.
families.basis: Reviewed rocker previews and explicit deputy-sheriff role labels. Colour is retained as a variant attribute, not evidence of a manufacturing date.

families.label: Corrections title rocker
families.description: Detached Corrections title in white, gold and green-and-gold.
families.basis: Reviewed title layout; all three are distinct source-labelled occurrences.

families.label: Sheriff / Deputy Sheriff waisted shield
families.description: Waisted shield with a role title above full arms and the province below.
families.basis: Reviewed S56-O02 and S56-O03 previews. Rectangular and rounded sheriff shields have different layouts and stay separate.

families.label: B.C.G.S. semicircle
families.description: Gold-lettered semicircular Alouette River Unit and Camps designs.
families.basis: Reviewed gold arch silhouettes and title arrangement. The initials remain unresolved in the source catalogue.

families.label: Numbered Park Ranger metal badge
families.description: Earlier metal shield with provincial arms, Park Ranger title and an individual number plate.
families.basis: Same ranger-metal-early atlas family. Numbers 174, 229, 266 and 120 are separate specimens of this layout; green-inset later badges stay separate.
